title: Acceptance when the matrix product is correct
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\phi$ be a probability density on the binary cube of dimension $n$, and let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over the two-element field. If $C'=AB$, then the matrix-product verification acceptance probability under $\phi$ is one.
hypotheses_covered: A probability density on the binary cube of dimension $n
Three $n\times n$ matrices over the two-element field
The third matrix equals the product of the first two
